description: Defines types and validation functions for message attachments in Mattermost, including MessageAttachment and MessageAttachmentField types, and functions to validate arrays and individual attachments.

methods.name: isMessageAttachmentArray
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is an array of MessageAttachment objects.

methods.name: isMessageAttachment
methods.description: Validates if an object conforms to the MessageAttachment type.

methods.name: isMessageAttachmentField
methods.description: Validates if an object conforms to the MessageAttachmentField type.
